Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: John <jhofweber327@comcast.net>
Sent: Friday, December 11, 2015 6:35 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Tiger acquisitioins

Thanks Anthony, and good job on reporting the good news (I hope). The only downside is that we continue to squander promising young players (they're called "prospects" when let go of). And so the team is populated with middle-age and older players, and the payroll is high. I thought it had finally caught up with the Tigers at the mid-point of last season, but Mr. I apparently wants to roll the dice one more time. The key factor, of course, is injuries. If Miggy, Iggy, Victor, and Anibal in particular stay reasonably healthy, the Tigers have a great chance to play into October.

BTW, tell the boss that those sudden, loud, intrusive ad clips played before and after each video are . . . just that. I usually mute them and scroll down to block the visual, and settle for reading the text. They discourage me from even opening the link in many instances. There should at least be a "skip this ad" option as is often seen on other sites.
